document: Alone Against the Dark Defying the Triumph of the Ice (A Solo Play Call of Cthulhu Mini Campaign) Chaosium Publication 23154 (Matthew Costello, Mike Mason, Petr Štovik etc.) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
The amulet summons a bizarre barrel-shaped creature, 
with what looks like a mutated starfish for a head! Make 
a Sanity roll and lose 0/1D6 Sanity points.
This is an Old One (see Elder Thing, page 291, Call of 
Cthulhu Rulebook). If you can make a successful Dodge 
roll, you can get away—return to 568. Otherwise, you’ll 
have to try communicating with the creature, go to 432.
(568)
